0022600159.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-4, eighth in the East, third in the Southeast and 0.5 games back) host the Detroit Pistons (5-1, second in the East, first in the Central) in their eighth game of the season, with Charlotte on a three-game losing streak and Detroit on a two-game winning streak. The Hornets trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 97-89 loss in Detroit on October 28, and they lost all three meetings with the Pistons in 2025-26. Charlotte is missing Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, both out with hamstring injuries, while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain).
